notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
-Added Korean language

-PC: DPad now works for menu navigation
-PC: Improved controller icon for center buttons
-Improved tutorial UI: L01Z03, L01Z18, L01Z19, L02Z22, L02Z24, L02Z03, L02Z04, L03Z26

notes.title: Flowing Lights Demo is here!
notes.notes:
The Demo is very light to download (70MB) and you’ll have fun for about 8-16 minutes or more depending on the challenge you want to achieve!

Going through the demo content should be fun for all players, the two last Zones might be a little more difficult!

[b]Rank A[/b]

Players who want more challenge should try to achieve Rank A in all sections, that is, gain a good understanding of how the game works and then retry a few more times to achieve Rank A (Retry key is ‘R’ or pressing “right stick” button, check option/game menu for automatic retry when under a certain Rank)

[b]Rank S[/b]

Players who want an even greater challenge and see the full potential of the game should try to achieve Rank S in each Zone. To do that, it’s recommended to make a first run to discover and get used to the controls. Then re-launch the demo level and try to achieve rank S every time (check the option/game for helpful options). The game will test your speed, precision and problem solving skills, especially in the ending Zones that are closer to the full game’s difficulty level. Rank S in Zone 17 can be achieved in at least 3 different ways, rare will be players who can find all 3 :-)

[b]Leaderboards[/b]

Well, Achieving Rank S faster than other players can be fun too :-) More leaderboards options are planned in the full game.
